verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows developer docs, SCIM APIs, event hooks, and an official MCP server for AI agents, but none of it references official language SDKs (e.g., Node/Java/Python SDKs) that an AI-native developer could build against; the MCP server is a tool-calling interface, not an SDK. missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation/repos, language-specific SDK examples, versioning/release notes for SDKs.
